TechMart Electronics — Frequently Asked Questions
(FAQ)
Official Corporate Policy & Reference Documentation | Doc ID: TM-FAQ-2026-V1
1. General & Account Management
Welcome to TechMart Electronics. Below are the most common inquiries regarding your account, online orders, and support
access.
(cid:127) How do I reset my password? Navigate to the TechMart login screen, click 'Forgot Password', and enter your
registered email. A 6-digit verification code will be sent immediately.

(cid:127) Can I change my account email? Yes, go to Account Settings > Security > Update Email Address. Email changes
require re-authentication.
(cid:127) What are TechMart customer support hours? Our Multi-Agent AI system is active 24/7/365. Human specialist
escalation is available Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM EST.
(cid:127) How do I track my active order? Once your order is processed, a tracking number from FedEx, UPS, or DHL is
emailed to you and accessible under My Orders.

emailed to you and accessible under My Orders.
2. Payments, Billing & Subscriptions
(cid:127) What payment methods does TechMart accept? We accept Visa, MasterCard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay,
Google Pay, and TechMart Store Credit.
(cid:127) When am I charged for backordered items? You are only charged when your item enters the fulfillment and shipping
stage.
(cid:127) How does the SmartHub Pro Cloud subscription work? The cloud subscription offers unlimited 60-day camera backup

and AI scene recognition at $9.99/month or $99/year.
(cid:127) Can I pause my subscription? Yes, subscriptions can be paused for up to 90 days from the Billing Portal.
3. Hardware & Smart Device Troubleshooting
(cid:127) What should I do if my SmartHub Pro loses Wi-Fi connection? Ensure your router operates on 2.4 GHz or 5 GHz.
Press and hold the Reset button on the rear for 5 seconds until the LED pulses amber.

(cid:127) Is the SoundWave 500 speaker waterproof? The SoundWave 500 carries an IPX7 water resistance rating, tolerating
submersion up to 1 meter for 30 minutes.
(cid:127) How many devices can pair simultaneously with VisionStream 4K? The VisionStream 4K supports up to 8 Bluetooth
remotes and audio output channels simultaneously.
(cid:127) Where do I download device firmware updates? Firmware updates are delivered automatically Over-The-Air (OTA)
when connected to Wi-Fi.

when connected to Wi-Fi.
4. Returns, Exchanges & Warranty Quick Summary
(cid:127) What is the standard return window? Items purchased directly from TechMart can be returned within 30 days of
delivery in original condition.

(cid:127) Are shipping fees refundable? Standard shipping fees are non-refundable unless the return is due to an error by
TechMart or a defective product.
(cid:127) How do I file a warranty claim? Submit your serial number and proof of purchase via the TechMart Support Assistant
or at support.techmart.com.

TechMart Electronics — Hardware Setup & Quick-Start
Installation Guide
Official Corporate Policy & Reference Documentation | Doc ID: TM-IG-QUICKSTART-2026
1. TechMart SmartHub Pro Setup Steps
Follow these step-by-step instructions to initialize your SmartHub Pro in under 5 minutes.
(cid:127) Step 1 (Placement): Place the SmartHub Pro in a central, elevated location in your home, at least 3 feet away from
large metal objects or microwaves.

large metal objects or microwaves.
(cid:127) Step 2 (Power): Connect the included 12V power adapter. The OLED display will illuminate and show the TechMart
logo.
(cid:127) Step 3 (App Pairing): Open the TechMart App on iOS/Android. Ensure Bluetooth is enabled on your phone and tap
'Add New Device (+)' in the top right corner.
(cid:127) Step 4 (Network Selection): Select your 2.4 GHz or 5 GHz Wi-Fi network and enter the passphrase. The front LED will
turn Solid Blue when connected.

turn Solid Blue when connected.
(cid:127) Step 5 (Matter/Zigbee Discovery): Put your smart accessories in pairing mode; the SmartHub Pro will automatically
detect and bind them.
2. TechMart SoundWave 500 Bluetooth & Wi-Fi Pairing
(cid:127) Bluetooth Mode: Power on the speaker. Press and hold the Bluetooth button for 3 seconds until the blue LED flashes
rapidly. Select 'SoundWave 500' on your mobile device.

(cid:127) Stereo Pair Mode: To link two SoundWave 500 speakers for true Left/Right stereo audio, double-tap the 'Link' button
on both units simultaneously within 10 seconds.
(cid:127) Auxiliary Input: Plug a 3.5mm audio cable into the AUX port; the speaker switches to Aux mode automatically.
3. TechMart VisionStream 4K TV Connection
(cid:127) Step 1: Plug the HDMI 2.1 cable into the HDMI 1 / eARC port of your 4K television.

(cid:127) Step 2: Connect the USB-C power supply directly into a wall outlet (avoid low-power TV USB ports).
(cid:127) Step 3: Switch TV source to the corresponding HDMI input and follow on-screen remote pairing (hold Home + Back
for 5 seconds).

TechMart Electronics — Product Specifications &
Technical Catalog
Official Corporate Policy & Reference Documentation | Doc ID: TM-PROD-SPEC-2026
1. TechMart SmartHub Pro (IoT Automation Gateway)
The central brain for modern smart homes. Manages Zigbee 3.0, Z-Wave Plus, Thread, Matter, and dual-band Wi-Fi 6
devices with sub-10ms local automation execution.
(cid:127) Processor: Quad-Core ARM Cortex-A55 @ 2.0 GHz, 2GB LPDDR4 RAM, 16GB eMMC storage.

(cid:127) Connectivity: Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax), Bluetooth 5.3 LE, Thread / Matter border router, Gigabit Ethernet.
(cid:127) Audio/Display: 3.5-inch OLED status display, built-in dual omnidirectional far-field microphones.
(cid:127) Power: 12V / 2A DC adapter with optional internal 2600mAh battery backup (up to 4 hours runtime).
(cid:127) Dimensions & Weight: 120mm x 120mm x 35mm, 320 grams.
2. TechMart SoundWave 500 (Wireless Hi-Res Smart Speaker)

Studio-grade acoustic fidelity engineered with dual custom neodymium woofers and high-efficiency silk dome tweeters.
(cid:127) Acoustic Output: 60W Total RMS output (80W Peak), Frequency Response: 42 Hz – 22 kHz.
(cid:127) Supported Codecs: LDAC, aptX HD, AAC, SBC, Apple AirPlay 2, Spotify Connect, and TIDAL Connect.
(cid:127) Battery & Ingress: 5200mAh Li-ion battery (up to 14 hours playback @ 60% volume), IPX7 waterproof.

(cid:127) Microphones: 4-mic beamforming array with noise cancellation for crystal clear voice commands.
3. TechMart VisionStream 4K (Cinematic HDR Media Hub)
Next-generation 4K HDR streaming device powered by TechMart OS with AV1 hardware decoding and Dolby Atmos
passthrough.
(cid:127) Video Support: 4K UHD @ 60fps, Dolby Vision, HDR10+, HLG, AV1, VP9 Profile 2.
(cid:127) Audio Passthrough: Dolby Atmos, DTS:X, 7.1 TrueHD surround sound over HDMI 2.1 eARC.

(cid:127) Memory & Storage: 4GB RAM, 32GB High-Speed Storage for games and offline streaming apps.
(cid:127) Ports: HDMI 2.1, USB 3.0 Type-A (for external hard drives), USB-C Power, Optical SPDIF.

TechMart Electronics — Customer Refund & Return
Policy
Official Corporate Policy & Reference Documentation | Doc ID: TM-POL-REFUND-2026
1. 30-Day Return Guarantee
At TechMart Electronics, customer satisfaction is our highest priority. If you are not completely satisfied with your purchase,
you may return eligible items within 30 calendar days of delivery for a full refund or exchange.

(cid:127) Items must be in original, undamaged condition with all accessories, cables, documentation, and packaging included.
(cid:127) Proof of purchase (Order ID or invoice receipt) is mandatory for all return requests.
(cid:127) Software licenses, downloaded digital media, and gift cards are strictly non-refundable.
(cid:127) Opened in-ear audio products (such as EarBuds Pro) are subject to health & hygiene return regulations and require
inspection before refund clearance.
2. Refund Processing Timelines

2. Refund Processing Timelines
Once returned merchandise is received at our fulfillment hub, our inspection team inspects the hardware within 48 to 72
business hours.
3. Restocking Fees & Return Shipping Costs
TechMart provides prepaid return labels for all items deemed defective on arrival (DOA) or shipped in error. For
discretionary returns (e.g., buyer remorse or wrong color chosen):
(cid:127) A flat return shipping fee of $8.99 will be deducted from your final refund amount.

(cid:127) A 15% restocking fee applies to opened electronics missing original interior packaging or manuals.
(cid:127) Refurbished / Open-Box products carry a 14-day return window with no restocking fee.
4. Step-by-Step Return Instructions
(cid:127) Step 1: Contact TechMart AI Support or sign in to your dashboard under My Orders.
(cid:127) Step 2: Select the item to return and select the reason code.
(cid:127) Step 3: Download and print the generated Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) label.
(cid:127) Step 4: Pack the device securely and drop off at any authorized FedEx / UPS depot.

TechMart Electronics — Shipping, Delivery & Fulfillment
Policy
Official Corporate Policy & Reference Documentation | Doc ID: TM-POL-SHIP-2026
1. Domestic Shipping Options (United States & Canada)
TechMart Electronics partners with FedEx, UPS, and DHL Express to ensure rapid, reliable delivery of all electronics,
audio equipment, and smart home accessories.
2. Order Cut-Off Times & Order Processing
Orders placed before 2:00 PM EST Monday through Friday are processed and dispatched on the same business day.

Orders placed after 2:00 PM EST or on weekends/holidays will ship on the following business day.
Signature Requirement: Orders exceeding $300 in value require an adult signature upon delivery.

3. International Shipping Rates & Customs Duties

3. International Shipping Rates & Customs Duties
TechMart delivers to over 45 countries worldwide. International shipping rates are calculated at checkout based on
package weight and destination country.
Customs duties, import taxes, and brokerage fees are the sole responsibility of the recipient and are not included in
TechMart's shipping charge. Duties are estimated at checkout where available.
4. Shipment Tracking & Delivery Confirmation

4. Shipment Tracking & Delivery Confirmation
A shipment confirmation email with carrier tracking number is sent automatically within 1 hour of dispatch. Track your
order at: orders.techmart.com/track or directly on the carrier's website.
Real-time GPS tracking is available for Priority Overnight and Saturday Express shipments.

All TechMart shipments are fully insured up to their retail value. If your order arrives damaged or is confirmed lost by

TechMart Electronics — Limited Hardware Warranty &
TechMart Care+
Official Corporate Policy & Reference Documentation | Doc ID: TM-WARR-2026
1. Standard One-Year Limited Manufacturer Warranty
TechMart Electronics warrants all brand-new hardware products against defects in materials and workmanship under
normal operational use for a period of ONE (1) YEAR from the original retail purchase date.

(cid:127) Scope of Coverage: Covers internal motherboard failure, defective Wi-Fi/Bluetooth chips, factory display defects,
power supply failure, and manufacturing defects.
(cid:127) Remedy: At TechMart's sole discretion, we will either (a) repair the product using new or refurbished OEM parts, (b)
replace the product with an identical or functionally equivalent model, or (c) refund the original purchase price.
2. What is NOT Covered Under Standard Warranty (Exclusions)

(cid:127) Cosmetic damage including scratches, dents, cracked plastics, or broken ports caused by accidental drops.
(cid:127) Liquid damage or moisture ingress exceeding the product's certified IP rating.
(cid:127) Damage resulting from unauthorized repair, disassembly, third-party software rooting, or electrical power surges.
(cid:127) Consumable parts such as standard batteries, unless failure is attributable to manufacturing defect.

(cid:127) Products purchased from unauthorized third-party resellers or auction platforms.
3. TechMart Care+ Extended Protection Plan (Optional 2-Year Plan)
Customers can purchase TechMart Care+ within 30 days of hardware purchase for extended protection.
4. How to File a Warranty Claim
(cid:127) Step 1: Locate your device Serial Number (printed on bottom label or under Settings > About).
(cid:127) Step 2: Start a conversation with TechMart AI Support or visit support.techmart.com/warranty.

(cid:127) Step 3: Provide a brief description of the defect and your original order number.
(cid:127) Step 4: Receive a prepaid shipping label and RMA number for inspection and swift repair/replacement.
